evidence.curator_note: Eq 8.1, bottom pathway: the distonic radical cation .CH2-CH2-CH2-CH(+)-CH3 (bottom structure, dHf 9.6) fragments by the arrow labeled 'alpha' (rate 1.1) to neutral ethylene C2H4 (dHf 0.5) plus the C3H6+. propene radical cation ((100%) base peak, dHf/IE 9.9(9.7)). This is radical-site (alpha) cleavage / beta-scission of the terminal carbon radical: the C-C bond beta to the radical breaks, expelling ethylene and leaving the odd electron adjacent to the pre-existing charge (propene radical cation). Book draws 0 curved arcs (energetics scheme). All 3 fishhooks reconstructed for balance: (1) the odd electron on C1 forms the new C1=C2 pi bond (ethylene), (2) one electron of the breaking C2-C3 sigma bond also forms that pi bond, (3) the other electron of C2-C3 stays on C3 as the new radical. The precursor distonic ion matches the book drawing directly. The product propene radical cation is encoded in its opened distonic localized form .CH2-CH(+)-CH3 (convention C); McLafferty draws the same species as the closed alkene CH3-CH=CH2 with a delocalized (+.) on the terminal carbon.

Cross-linked MOD rule IMS_8_1_var3_step2 ('monomolecular ion-cleavage 8.1 alpha 1.1'). Its DFS cleaves the same C-C bond of the distonic ion (their C4-C7 = my C2-C3) to give a two-carbon neutral plus the C3H6 propene radical cation (their C7-C10=C12 with (+.) on the terminal C12), i.e. the SAME net alpha/beta-scission encoded here (loss of C2H4 giving C3H6+.). PARTIAL MISMATCH in the DFS: (1) the two-carbon neutral is written as a single-bonded fragment [C]1([H]2)([H]3)[C]4([H]5)([H]6) -- .CH2-CH2. , a 1,2-diradical -- rather than the closed-shell ethylene CH2=CH2 the book draws, which also raises the unpaired-electron count on the RHS (a spin non-conservation the L->R guardrail should catch); and (2) it bundles an extra H-migration (H11, C10->C7) into the step. The clean beta-scission encoded here (ethylene + propene radical cation, no spurious diradical, no extra H shift) reproduces the drawn products faithfully.

Book prints '(100%)' next to the C3H6+. propene radical cation, i.e. it is the base peak of the spectrum. observed_mz 42.0464 is the curator-computed electron-mass-corrected monoisotopic m/z of C3H6+. (m/z 42); the page prints only the % abundance and dHf/IE (9.9(9.7) eV), no m/z.
